name: Planview AgilePlace
description: Planview AgilePlace is an enterprise Kanban and lean work-management product for visualizing flow, coordinating delivery and improving how work moves across teams. Organizations use configurable boards, lanes, cards, connections and analytics to manage work from strategy through execution.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned AgilePlace bearer token and exact tenant hostname. Selected agents can use seven bounded board and card actions under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; descriptions, identities, attachments, administration, advanced fields, raw API access and bulk operations remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: PLANVIEW_AGILEPLACE_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: AgilePlace API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A separate bearer token created by the intended least-authority AgilePlace user and revoked when Relay is disconnected.

credentialRequirements.name: PLANVIEW_AGILEPLACE_ACCOUNT_HOSTNAME
credentialRequirements.label: AgilePlace account hostname
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact tenant hostname, such as example.leankit.com; Relay rejects every other host.

capabilities.label: Read boards
capabilities.description: List bounded visible boards and inspect one exact board.

capabilities.label: Read cards
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded card metadata without descriptions or identities.

capabilities.label: Manage cards
capabilities.description: Create minimal cards and version-check rename or deletion.

approvalRequired.label: List boards
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty bounded board summaries visible to the token user.

approvalRequired.label: Read board
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact AgilePlace board.

approvalRequired.label: List cards
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty metadata-only cards from one exact board.

approvalRequired.label: Read card
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact AgilePlace card.

approvalRequired.label: Create card
approvalRequired.description: Create one minimal card with a bounded title on one exact board.

approvalRequired.label: Rename card
approvalRequired.description: Rename one exact card after its title and resource version both match.

approvalRequired.label: Delete card
approvalRequired.description: Delete one exact card after its title and resource version both match.

blocked.label: Administer account or users
blocked.description: Account settings, users, teams, roles, invitations, SSO, SCIM, tokens and billing are unavailable.

blocked.label: Administer boards
blocked.description: Board creation, deletion, archival, layout, roles, members, filters, templates and WIP settings are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change advanced card data
blocked.description: Descriptions, assignments, custom fields, links, tags, dates, type, lane, dependencies, connections and task cards are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change attachments or comments
blocked.description: Attachment content and comment creation, update, deletion or export are unavailable.

blocked.label: Use automation or reporting APIs
blocked.description: Automations, custom events, planning series, advanced reporting, OData and user provisioning are outside this connection.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary AgilePlace calls
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose tenant origins, paths, query parameters, fields, JSON Patch operations or raw REST requests.

blocked.label: Run bulk or unbounded operations
blocked.description: Bulk mutation, cross-board search, exports and responses above twenty rows or 256 KiB are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Private reads and every card mutation require approval. Tenant binding, token-user authority, bounds, field allowlists, version checks and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All seven selected AgilePlace actions run without Relay per-action approval; tenant binding, token authority, bounds, field allowlists, version checks, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway executes seven fixed AgilePlace API v2 actions at one validated tenant with bearer authentication, bounds, redaction and resource-version checks.
Railway executes seven fixed AgilePlace API v2 actions at one validated tenant with bearer authentication, bounds, redaction and resource-version checks.

providerSetup.blocker: AgilePlace API access requires a customer account, a dedicated user with only the intended board roles and a separate non-expiring API token created in that user's My API Tokens profile tab.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console acceptance task, use a synthetic tenant, create a dedicated least-authority user and separate token, connect the exact tenant hostname, verify the seven bounded tools and permission denials, then revoke the token.

evidence.supports: The current official v2 core concepts document fixes the tenant API base at HTTPS /io, supports bearer tokens, and says tokens do not expire and should be revoked when unused.
Planview documents response rate-limit headers, 429 Retry-After handling, limited concurrency and incremental bounded reads.
The official card-list reference documents board filtering, offset and limit paging, field selection, search and page metadata.
The official create-card reference documents a minimal board destination and title request.
The official update-card reference documents JSON Patch and optimistic concurrency through the card version.
Planview describes AgilePlace as enterprise Kanban and lean work management for visualizing work, improving flow and coordinating delivery.
